newsitem.title: USA: David White says sale negotiations ended.
newsitem.headline: David White says sale negotiations ended.

text.p: David White Inc said on Friday that negotiations on the potential sale of the company have terminated.
The compnay said that, although its board of directors is not actively seeking a buyer, there are continuing indications of interest from other parties.
The board will continue to utilize independent, outside advice in evaluating any potential offer with a view toward maximizing shareholder value, the company said.
The negotiations were first announced last November.
Earlier Friday, the company reported a net loss of $23,000 or $0.05 a share in the third quarter, compared to a $136,000 or $0.30 a share profit a year ago.

"The third quarter, traditionally one of our slowest, was affected this year by severe summer weather which slowed construction in some parts of the country and by an uncertain interest- rate picture," said Tony Mihalovich, chief executive officer of the Germantown manufacturer of optical and laser surveying instruments. "The quarter ended strongly, however, and we are optimistic about the remainder of the year."
